name: voiceink.best-asr

model.backend: FluidAudio Core ML, live transcription on

notes: Maintainer's release in its 7-day trial: it starts at the first launch (the date goes into the login Keychain, which the bench never writes); after it every paste starts with an upgrade notice, which stops the run (refusal_text). Validate in a VM; on a host, launch it only in the account and on the night of its runs. Onboarding's local path: starter Dictation mode (text formatting on, live transcription on); shortcut Right Option (onboarding asks, no default), recording mode hybrid (default). best-asr: Parakeet Ultra, language English. VoiceInk marks no model as recommended in its library; its v2.27 registry rates Ultra 0.95 (V3 0.94) and describes it as 'Parakeet V3 post-trained by Moondream for more accurate transcription'; of the models tied at 0.95 it is listed first and the one described as more accurate.
